text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
Moss's notes have two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers:

1. **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell logged it on 4 Oct 2025: at the Eau Claire yard, drivers checking in by tablet for the 04:00 shift at Dock Doors 14–18 weren't getting their bay-assignment texts. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed on 5 Oct that the next 04:00 shift got through the gate without help.
2. **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. The note says it went up to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing. The note has no date, so I can't tell when that was.

Things to know before you paste these in:
- #4419 doesn't have the "PD-" prefix the other one has. I've copied both exactly as Moss wrote them.
- Moss's 14 Sep 2025 North digest and 23 Mar 2026 renewal note both mention Quarrendon but have no ticket numbers.
- Moss's 2 Jan 2026 Central digest has tickets #4409 and #4412, but those belong to Marrow Fieldworks, so I left them out.
- Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways" (one r) is about a different company that isn't a customer, so I left it out too.

I only looked through Moss's shared files, not channel messages. I can also check #north-team or #inc-qfl-sev1 for tickets if you'd like.
